column1: # Base-class virtual methods (28 Oct 2026). Slot = vtable offset / 4. See re/vtables.md.

column4: empty function; fills vtable slots 0, 1 and 7 of the base classes (and was the clock destructor)
base slot 2: if object has animation (flag bit 4) advance AnimPlayer via 00401860
base slot 3: recomputes bounds rect (+0x10..+0x1c) and screen position (+0x20..+0x2c) from the current frame record (0x24-byte entries); calls slot 2 in between
base slot 8: sets flag bit 1 (+0x68) from argument

base slot 9: reads from a stream: current bank index (+0x32), per-frame fields of the current sequence (+0x24, +0x26, +0x30, +0x18) and an optional blob of +0x64 bytes at +0x60. Save-game deserialisation
base slot 10: mirror of LoadState using fwrite. Save-game serialisation
default for update/draw-style slots: returns 0
base slot 12 default (ret 8)
base slot 11 default (ret 4)
base slot 6 default (draw with one argument)
MidBase slots 2 (and 3 in some classes): AnimTick then zero the current sequence's x/y offset (+0x28, +0x2a)

MidBase slot 4: when a click is pending (+0x8c), clears it, removes the object from the main list, runs the verb handler for the current verb (index +0x9c, slots 20-26), clears the cursor's target (+0x12c), resets the cursor animation and calls slot 27 with verb-7. Pending flag is cleared at the end
MidBase slot 6: converts world position to screen (camera at argument, +0x140/+0xf0 centre) and queues the current frame's image through Display_AddSprite with the object's sort value (+0x5e)
MidBase slot 13: tells the player object (global 004420fc) to select verb +0x90, then dispatches the verb handler like Interactive_Update
MidBase slot 14: stores verb +0x9c then calls slot 19 (OnClick)
MidBase slot 15: calls slot 14 with its argument
MidBase slot 16: returns 1 (is interactive/enabled default)
MidBase slot 17: puts the object's phrase text (+0x6c record, then the 64-bit name key) into the cursor's hover text via Cursor_SetText
MidBase slot 18: Cursor_SetText(null)

MidBase slot 19: interrupts the player if busy, copies the clicked verb for the player object itself, sets the player's target to the object's approach point (+0x94,+0x98) via player slot 32 (walk), then player slot 4
MidBase slot 20: marks click pending (+0x8c, +0x8d), says phrase key +0x70 if set via GameState_Say, sets cursor busy, inserts object into the main list at priority 5
slot 21 of Kind09-based classes: same pattern with phrase key +0x74 and a default phrase when unset
slot 23: phrase key +0x78
slot 22: phrase key +0x7c
slot 24: phrase key +0x80
slot 27: handles using an inventory item on the object: looks the item up in the object's item table (+0xa0 pairs of name keys, +0xa4 responses) else says a default phrase (ICON01T058 or MODELO2)
MidBase slot 27 default (ret 4, returns 0)
slot 4 of the kind 5 class family: runs Interactive_Update unless deferred, polls keyboard/mouse button state and the sound manager to stop a playing sound on input, calls slot 28
slot 6 of the kind 5 class family: wraps Obj_Draw with slot 31 calls depending on flags +0xd4/+0xc/+0xd5
see ledger note
copies a C string into the cursor's hover-text buffer (+0x78), or clears it; optional ushort at +0x118
(x, y, sort value, image, flag): clips a 640x480 sprite and queues it in the render rows (per-scanline lists) by image type (1 or 3 get extra passes)
removes the node holding the given object from the main list
